title: Five books for a rainy weekend
summary: Put the kettle on and let the rain do its thing. These are the books I reach for when the weekend is grey and the blanket is calling.

books.title: The Night Circus
books.author: Erin Morgenstern
books.note: A mysterious circus that only opens at night, and two young magicians bound to a contest they don't fully understand. Read it for the atmosphere alone.

books.title: Howl's Moving Castle
books.author: Diana Wynne Jones
books.note: Sophie is cursed into an old woman and ends up cleaning a wizard's walking castle. Funny, warm and far wiser than it looks.

books.title: Legends & Lattes
books.author: Travis Baldree
books.note: An orc warrior hangs up her sword to open a coffee shop. Low stakes, found family and fresh baking. Pure comfort.

books.title: Anxious People
books.author: Fredrik Backman
books.note: A bungled bank robbery turns into a hostage situation at an apartment viewing. Ridiculous, tender and quietly moving.

books.title: The Midnight Library
books.author: Matt Haig
books.note: Between life and death, Nora finds a library where every book is a life she could have lived. A gentle story about regret and hope.
